catalog.readOnly: You can view this section, but not edit it.

image.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. It is optimized automatically.

company.intro: This information appears on your booking page.
company.legalHint:
Shown on the public pages. Basic formatting is allowed (

, , , lists, headings and links); any other tag is removed on save.

categories.name: Category name
categories.emptyEditable: Create a category (for example, Haircuts) and then add its services.
categories.singleChoice: Only one service from this category per appointment
categories.singleChoiceHint: Example: Haircuts. Customers can't book two haircuts together, but they can add a beard trim or brows.

services.intro: Active services appear in online booking.
services.emptyCategory: This category has no services yet.
services.name: Name
services.bufferHint: Break after the service before the next appointment.
services.activeHint: If you deactivate it, it is no longer offered for booking.
services.requiresResourceHint: Only booked when a workstation (chair, bed…) is free.
services.deleteConfirm: Delete the service {{name}}? It will no longer be offered by anyone on the team.

resources.intro: Chairs, beds or tables that some services need free.
resources.empty: There are no workstations. You only need them if a service requires one.
resources.name: Name

team.intro: Your team and the services each person offers.
team.name: Name customers see
team.commissionHint: Used when a service has no other commission.
team.activeHint: If you deactivate them, they get no new appointments.
team.onlineHint: If not, they can only be booked from the panel.
team.offersHint: Tick the services they offer. Leave price, duration or commission blank to use the general value.
team.noOffers: They offer no services yet: they will not appear in booking.
team.noServicesYet: Create services in the Services section to assign them.
team.deleteConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the team? They will stop receiving appointments.

hours.intro: Each professional's weekly schedule and the days or hours they are not available.
hours.blocksHint: Vacations, doctor visits or any time they do not see customers. Upcoming ones are shown.
hours.deleteBlockConfirm: Delete this time off? Those hours become available again.
hours.noProfile: Your account is not linked to a professional profile yet. Ask the owner to link it.
